differences.writeup_quote: The idea comes from this repo's centring results: the family mean's gain for association is the removal of the shared continuation prior, and from the frequency-debiased-readout paper, which locates the crowding in input-independent tokens.
differences.what: The write-up explicitly credits the method's idea to an external prior-work paper (the frequency-debiased-readout paper) in addition to the repo's own internal notes/results, and frames the method as recovering that paper's identified effect 'with no mean and no target information.' The closing message discusses the internal repo notes (notes/predictions.md) in similar or greater numeric detail, but never names or alludes to the external paper at all, so a reader of only the message would not learn that the method builds on or reproduces insight from a prior-work paper.

rationale: The write-up credits an external prior-work paper (the 'frequency-debiased-readout paper') as a joint source of the method's idea alongside the repo's own internal centring notes, framing the contribution as recovering that paper's identified effect without a mean or target info. The closing message discusses the internal repo notes in comparable (even more quantified) detail but omits any mention of the external paper, so it understates the write-up's crediting of outside prior work while matching it on the internally-sourced insight.
